messages:
Nina H: quick sync  we need a clear SI co-sell handoff for the cloud-marketplace + HW partner bundle. main Q: single ownership vs shared claim?
Raj P: prefer single ownership to avoid duplicate outreach. ownership decision based on mapping priority:
  1) AE CRM owner (named accounts)
  2) SI partner if partner_intent tag present and ACV >=50k
  3) marketplace-led queue for discovery/opps
Ethan M: +1 but add a tie-breaker: if multiple SI partners express interest, mark as "multi-SI" and run a partner-selection auction (ops handles outreach). avoid assigning to multiple SIs automatically.
Clara V: also need rules for hardware SKUs that require on-prem validation. those should route to "hw-validation" channel and block auto-claim until validation ok.
Nina H: good call. can we capture this in routing pseudo?
Ethan M: here's a concise sketch:
```text
if account.is_named:
  assign -> AE_owner
elif 'partner_intent' in account.tags and account.acv >= 50000:
  assign -> SI_claim_queue
elif 'hw_onprem_required' in account.tags:
  assign -> hw_validation_queue (hold auto-claim)
else:
  assign -> marketplace_discovery_queue
```
ops-bot: Claim created: "BluePeak Networks" -> SI_claim_queue. claim=CLM-7721. notified: #partnerships @ops-team :robot_face:
Raj P: ops-bot should always DM AE/SE if AE exists, and post to #partnerships. set claim TTL 72h for acceptance, then auto-escalate to partner-leads.
Clara V: also add recent-contact suppression: if AE/SE contacted account.primary_contact within last 10 days, route back to AE and annotate claim with "recent-contact". reduces churn.
Nina H: for multi-SI interest, ops-run selection: we will open a 48h window for partner bids (email template needed). whoever commits fastest gets the claim; ops annotates pipeline.
Ethan M: i will add logic for SKU validation + multi-SI flag in routing service and open PR: https://git.internal/redwood/si-routing/pull/204 (WIP)
Nina H: can someone draft a short FAQ + sample DM/email snippets before the vendor sync on Thurs? I can present it there.
Raj P: i'll draft snippets and a sample escalation timeline.
Clara V: i'll add hw-validation checklist and quick template for partner ops to use.
Nina H: thanks — let's run a pilot next week with 5 accounts and the two HW partners. that should surface any gaps. :rocket:
